title: Captain Carrot and His Amazing Zoo Crew #17 DC 1983 Newsqueak Cover Roy Thomas
condition_description: Bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
description:
Captain Carrot and His Amazing Zoo Crew! #17 (July 1983), DC Comics - Special three-in-one incognito issue, "Newsqueak" Super-Hero Team of the Year cover by Rick Hoberg. Created by Roy Thomas, Gerry Conway and Scott Shaw. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: Mattel Intellivision Lock 'n' Chase ad.

Condition: bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
